news_notes: Nvidia's up-to-$105B financing backstop for OpenAI's Ohio data center (SB Energy/PORTS-Pike) is corroborated across Bloomberg, CNBC, 24/7 Wall St., and Invezz -- the single most-covered story of the sweep.
Stripe's $7B+ acquisition of OpenRouter (over 5x its $1.3B valuation from months ago) is independently confirmed by Bloomberg, Dataconomy, Tech Times, and Tech Startups.

Meta's California youth-safety trial (29 state AGs, up to $1.4 trillion in theoretical damages) is corroborated by HNGN, CNBC, and Fortune, with TradingKey separately confirming a same-day 3.63% stock drop tied to the trial plus raised AI capex guidance.
Higgsfield's $400M Series B at a $5.4B valuation (Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Intel Capital, DST Global) is corroborated by SiliconANGLE, Yahoo Finance, and citybiz.
Unitree's viral 'Superman' high-speed robot demo lands the same week as its first-ever Shanghai STAR Market debut for a humanoid robotics maker, corroborated across Aroged, Yahoo Finance, and Xinhua.
